nodes.reachability: Public in the library but reached in the protocol only from `doLegacyNote` (line 1342) at the end of `materializeLegacy` (line 1325). Two shapes: for a plain brew the whole buyback credits the collection ledger at `credit` (line 1313); for the iteration-2 continuation, where the generation's collection IS the MiFrens contract, the amount splits pro rata by fren count at `ogShare` (line 1307) and only the forged share reaches the ledger at `credit` (line 1311) — the OG share is RETURNED for the caller to fold into the genesis reserve. A zero population returns 0 at `total` (line 1305). The forged count is derived live from `totalMinted` (line 1303) minus the OG tranche.

nodes.name: materializeLegacy
nodes.signature: function materializeLegacy( IPositionManagerOps pm, address hook, address registryAddr, address ledger, address mifrens, uint256 genesisShares, uint256 gen, address genColl, address token, ReserveRef memory r, bool toReserve ) external returns (uint256 credited, uint256 ogShare)
nodes.value: ERC20 transfer of the hook's held live-buyback tokens into the registry at `sweepLegacyReserve` (line 1333); on the relaunch branch those tokens are burned at `burn` (line 1340)
nodes.authority: anyone directly at the linked library address; in the protocol path, anyone through the facet's permissionless materialization, or the relaunch flush
nodes.reachability: Two entries: the permissionless live path at `materializeLegacy` (RedemptionExt.sol:151) in `materializeLegacyReserve` (RedemptionExt.sol:147), which requires only that the machine is summoned, and the relaunch flush at `materializeLegacy` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1496) in `_flushLegacyAtRelaunch` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1494). It no-ops when the ledger is unwired at `ledger` (line 1331), when the hook points at a different registry at `legacyRegistry` (line 1332) or when nothing is pending at `amt` (line 1334). The `toReserve` (line 1335) flag selects the branch: live deposits into the reserve LP and credits only what the position actually absorbed at `credited` (line 1336), while the relaunch flush BURNS the dead token at `burn` (line 1340) and carries the same figure as a pure ledger number. The caller folds the returned OG share into the genesis reserve, e.g. at `genesisPending` (RedemptionExt.sol:158).

nodes.name: crystallizeCollection
nodes.signature: function crystallizeCollection( address ledger, address collection, address vault, uint256 gen, uint256 swept, uint256 activeBase, uint256 totalETH ) external returns (uint256 entitled)
nodes.authority: anyone directly at the linked library address; in the protocol path, anyone once the old pool is dead (the gate is on the registry side)
nodes.reachability: Delegatecalled once per death from `crystallizeCollection` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1026) inside `relaunch` (CauldronRegistry.sol:767). DENOMINATION: the dying vault's swept ETH is converted into the NEWBORN's token units at `mulDiv` (line 1356) using the new launch ratio activeBase/totalETH, so the entitlement is priced at the new pool's opening price, and the whole call no-ops when `totalETH` (line 1354) is zero, when the wiring is missing or when the generation already crystallized at `crystallized` (line 1355). The claimant base is frozen from the vault's own `outstanding` (line 1363), which already excludes the genesis tranche, and is zero when the generation has no vault.

nodes.name: recycleCollection
nodes.signature: function recycleCollection( IPositionManagerOps pm, address ledger, address collection, uint256 gen, uint256 tokenId, address caller, ReserveRef memory r ) external returns (uint256 amount)
nodes.value: moves the NFT from the caller to the registry at `custodyTransfer` (line 1409) and pays the floor in live tokens out of the reserve at `claimFromReserve` (line 1410)
nodes.authority: anyone directly at the linked library address; in the protocol path, the NFT's owner (ownership is checked here, the circuit breaker on the registry side)
nodes.reachability: Delegatecalled from `recycleCollection` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1518) in `recycleCollectionNFT` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1508), which is permissionless apart from the redemption circuit breaker at `_redeemBlocked` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1511) and the wiring check at `BadConfig` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1516). Ownership is asserted here at `ownerOf` (line 1380). SELF-CONFIGURING GUARD: the collection is probed for a genesis tranche with a staticcall at `GENESIS_SUPPLY` (line 1401), and ids inside it are refused at `ogCount` (line 1404) — a plain brew returns no data, leaving the check inert. Order is checks-effects: the ledger is debited at `redeem` (line 1408) and the NFT moved at `custodyTransfer` (line 1409) BEFORE the reserve is drawn at `claimFromReserve` (line 1410), and a short reserve rolls both back at `CLAIM_DUST` (line 1413).

nodes.name: buyCollection
nodes.signature: function buyCollection( IPositionManagerOps pm, address ledger, address collection, address token, uint256 gen, uint256 tokenId, address caller, ReserveRef memory r ) external returns (uint256 added)
nodes.value: ERC20 transferFrom of twice the floor from the buyer into the registry at `transferFrom` (line 1433), which is then deposited into the reserve at `addToReserve` (line 1434); the NFT goes to the buyer at `custodyTransfer` (line 1436)
nodes.authority: anyone directly at the linked library address; in the protocol path, anyone holding enough of the live token
nodes.reachability: Delegatecalled from `buyCollection` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1535) in `buyCollectionNFT` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1529), which is open to anyone and only requires the ledger and collection to be wired at `BadConfig` (CauldronRegistry.sol:1533). The NFT must already be treasury-held, asserted at `ownerOf` (line 1429); the price is twice the live ledger floor at `floorPerNFT` (line 1431) and zero is refused at `require` (line 1432). The payment is pulled with a checked `transferFrom` (line 1433), deposited into the reserve, and the ledger is ratcheted with what the position ACTUALLY absorbed at `added` (line 1435) rather than what was paid; the NFT changes hands last at `custodyTransfer` (line 1436).
